subject: GROUP

roles.ULT.loc.quote: is listed on the Singapore Exchange and incorporated and domiciled in Singapore

roles.ULT.attrs.group_revenue_eur.quote: the Group recognised total revenue of RMB3,515,528,000
roles.ULT.attrs.group_revenue_eur.basis: 2024 revenue RMB3,515,528,000 ÷ EUR/CNY central parity on 2024-12-31 of 7.5257 (official/fx/cny_central_parity.csv) = EUR467,136,346.12; kept after re-dating to 2026 (the threshold looks at the four preceding years; 2022 and 2025 are not disclosed)

roles.OP.loc.quote: Shandong Sunsine Chemical Co., Ltd. (Shanxian, Shandong, PRC)

roles.OP.attrs.incorporated_in.quote: Shandong Sunsine Chemical Co.,Ltd (a),(b) Manufacturing and sale of rubber chemicals, comprising rubber accelerators, anti-oxidant agents, anti-scorching agents and insoluble sulphur People’s Republic of China

holds.ULT>OP.ratio.quote: Held by the Company Shandong Sunsine Chemical Co.,Ltd (a),(b)

holds.ULT>OP.since.quote: Equity investments at cost Beginning and end of the financial year 350,010 350,010
holds.ULT>OP.since.formula: note 14: 100% held at both end-2023 and end-2024, and the 2024 investment cost is unchanged between opening and closing (pdf 83–84) — held continuously since 2023-12-31 at the latest; only a lower bound for the holding period, the real acquisition date is earlier and not disclosed

holds.ULT>OP.cost.quote: Equity investments at cost Beginning and end of the financial year 350,010
holds.ULT>OP.cost.formula: note 14, the Company's investment cost in subsidiaries 350,010 (RMB'000) × 1,000 = RMB350,010,000; the only subsidiary the Company holds directly is Shandong Sunsine (pdf 84)

flows.up1.foreign_taxed.quote: withholding tax on foreign dividend income 9,038
flows.up1.foreign_taxed.formula: the Mainland levies withholding tax on dividends paid to a non-resident enterprise (Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 3(3), Article 37); the group expensed 9,038 thousand for this item in 2024

flows.up1.foreign_headline_rate.quote: Tax calculated at tax rate of 25% (2023: 25%)

flows.up1.deductible_at_payer.formula: a dividend is a distribution of after-tax profit, not deductible by the payer (Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 10(1))

present.HOLD.formula: group structure chart: the Singapore company holds 100% of Shandong Sunsine directly (pdf 27, 84), with no intermediate holding company in between

present.financing.formula: the Company's funding of the subsidiary is recorded as the cost of an equity investment (note 14), and profits come up as dividends (note 11, dividends receivable from subsidiaries)

present.payment.quote: the non-trade receivables from subsidiary corporations included dividends receivables of RMB210,000,000 (2023: RMB180,000,000)
present.payment.formula: both year-ends show subsidiary dividends declared but unpaid — unpaid in the year of declaration, paid the following year

event.on.basis: re-dated: the real year is 2024, the library holds only current law (decision D30), moved to 2026-06-30

event.dividend.basis: the subsidiary's annual dividend to the parent is not disclosed separately; the dividend receivable from subsidiaries at end-2023, RMB180,000,000, is taken — close to the RMB180,760,000 implied by the 2024 withholding tax of 9,038 thousand at 5% (RMB90,380,000 at 10%)

company_estimate.quote: withholding tax on foreign dividend income 9,038
company_estimate.use: for comparison only: the dividend withholding tax expensed by the group in 2024; the corresponding dividend amount is not disclosed, so it is not the reference answer for this case's dividend — if the engine takes 5% on RMB180,000,000 it gets 9,000,000, the same order of magnitude

notes: Source: China Sunsine Chemical Holdings Ltd. (SGX) annual report 2024 (cases/sources/K3-sunsine-2024/source.pdf). K3 semi-synthetic: structure and ratios come from the annual report; the dividend amount and date are synthetic values (see provenance).

Only the part within the three jurisdictions is modelled: the Singapore listed company is recorded as ULT, its BVI parent Success More is out of scope; Shandong Sunsine (Mainland) is OP, and its own Mainland subsidiaries are not listed separately.

Amounts are in RMB. Not disclosed in the annual report: the Singapore tax residence certificate, whether the dividend is remitted to Singapore, the facts needed for the beneficial-owner determination — left for the program to ask.

names: each party's defined term / full name in the document (aliases separated by /), individuals written as in the document, used for locating extraction patterns, search queries and registry look-ups (抽取改造.md §2, §7)
